name: Manufacturing & Engineering
shortDescription: Specialized inventory accounting, cost allocations, inverted duty GST refunds, and factory compliance frameworks.
challenges: Complex raw material, WIP, and finished goods inventory valuation (AS-2 / Ind AS 2)
Working capital blockages resulting from inverted duty tax structures in GST
Factory Act, labour welfare, PF, ESIC, and multi-state compliance tracking
Scrap sales taxation, job work documentation, and statutory wastage disclosures
solutions: Automated standard cost systems and periodic variance reconciliation
Expedited inverted duty structure GST refund claim preparation and tracking
Monthly regulatory calendar covering factory statutory compliance
Job-work delivery challan reconciliations under GST Section 143

name: IT, Software & SaaS
shortDescription: Zero-rated export compliance, LUT filings, SaaS revenue recognition under Ind AS 115, and cross-border tax planning.
challenges: Complex recurring subscription revenue recognition across global timeframes
Foreign inward remittance verification (FIRC/e-BRC) and zero-rated GST audits
Transfer pricing documentation for cross-border software support and development
Equalisation levy and withholding tax requirements on international tech tools
solutions: Clean revenue recognition workflows aligned with Ind AS 115 / IFRS 15
Automated export LUT filings and streamlined GST refund procedures
Transfer pricing study reports and documentation compliance
Guidance on DTAA provisions to eliminate double withholding taxes on royalties

name: Startups & Emerging Ventures
shortDescription: DPIIT recognition, Section 80-IAC tax exemption, cap-table governance, and investor due diligence preparation.
challenges: Navigating complex startup exemptions under Section 56(2)(viib) and Section 80-IAC
Messy cap-tables, ESOP structuring, and convertible note accounting
Limited runway requiring aggressive cash burn monitoring and unit economic clarity
Strict financial due diligence expectations from seed and venture capital investors
solutions: Turnkey DPIIT startup registration and tax holiday application filings
ESOP scheme formulation, valuation certificates, and cap-table structuring
Virtual CFO financial models projecting runway, CAC, LTV, and burn rate
Pre-due diligence audit cleanup to ensure seamless equity rounds

name: Real Estate & Construction
shortDescription: RERA compliance, project quarterly account filings, Joint Development Agreement (JDA) tax structuring, and GST.
challenges: Complex revenue recognition on project completion vs percentage-of-completion
Stringent RERA separate bank account escrow rules and CA certification mandates
GST input tax credit restrictions on commercial and residential residential construction
Capital gains tax liabilities arising from Joint Development Agreements (JDAs)
solutions: Statutory RERA Form-3 CA certifications for project withdrawals
JDA tax planning under Section 45(5A) of the Income Tax Act
Accurate cost tracking and project-level accounting to prevent escrow violations
Handling real estate GST departmental scrutiny and input reconciliations

name: Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals
shortDescription: Doctor/hospital accounting, pharmaceutical batch costing, GST exemptions, and equipment lease structuring.
challenges: Navigating mixed supplies: tax-exempt healthcare vs taxable medicines and room rent
High capital expenditure on advanced medical machinery requiring optimum tax depreciation
Multi-doctor consulting fee TDS deductions under Section 194J and 194M
Stringent pharmacy inventory controls and expiry stock write-offs
solutions: Clear separation of exempt health services and taxable institutional revenues
Tax-efficient equipment leasing and Section 32 depreciation optimization
Automated monthly TDS processing for hospital visiting consultants
Pharmacy stock accounting and batch-level expiration reconciliation

name: Retail & E-commerce
shortDescription: Multi-channel POS reconciliation, TCS compliance under GST Section 52, inventory turn tracking, and returns.
challenges: High volume of micro-transactions from marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify)
Tax Collected at Source (TCS) tracking and reconciliation with marketplace statements
Inventory shrinkages, returns (RTO), and damaged stock write-off documentation
Multi-state GST registrations for Principle and Additional Places of Business (PPoB/APoB)
solutions: Automated ingestion of marketplace settlements into accounting software
Monthly GSTR-8 TCS reconciliation against GST returns to prevent cash leakage
Inventory turn and gross margin reporting by SKU and category
Seamless multi-state GST registration and state-wise return management

name: Agriculture & Agro-Processing
shortDescription: Agricultural income tax exemptions, FPO structuring, food processing subsidies, and cold-chain compliance.
challenges: Distinguishing pure exempt agricultural income from taxable agro-processing profits
Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) governance and compliance with Section 80P
Documentation required to prove agricultural land sales exemption under Section 2(14)
Availing government subsidies and grants for food processing infrastructure
solutions: Clear tax bifurcation between farming operations and industrial agro-processing
End-to-end statutory audit, incorporation, and ROC compliance for FPOs
Statutory certification for rural agricultural land classification and capital gains exemption
Assistance with NABARD and Ministry of Food Processing subsidy audits

name: NGOs, Trusts & Section 8
shortDescription: Section 12AB registration, 80G tax exemption certificates, FCRA compliance, and grant audit certifications.
challenges: Mandatory re-registration and renewals under Section 12AB and 80G
Strict utilisation thresholds (85% rule) and Form 9A/10 accumulation requirements
Strict FCRA regulations on receiving and deploying foreign philanthropic contributions
Donor-mandated statutory fund utilization certificates and transparency
solutions: Turnkey handling of Form 10A and Form 10AB for 12AB and 80G registrations
Audit of charitable income and expenditure with Form 10B/10BB electronic filing
Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA) audit and Form FC-4 annual returns
Project-specific fund utilization certificates for institutional and CSR donors
